question: Which selected native deadline check requests a victory result separately from ordinary victory conditions, and what limits a candidate extension?

scope.boundary: Exact evaluator entry, rank-pointer setup and advance, complete local warning and deadline arm, immediate continuation and shared result prefix; census of immediate forms with limited coverage. Result-writer completion, callback implementations, exhaustive limit-reader and limit-writer coverage and runtime ending are outside this scope.

dependencies.use: Current turn and year scalars, native converter and selected transition producer.
Separate ordinary Domination palace and elapsed-ten-turn conditions.
Zero-based ordinal producer and transfer, under its condition, of the stride-32 ranking table; current rank freshness remains separate.
Identity of 0x8312B8D4 as the selected scenario identifier, including the exact -1 sentinel; no current runtime value is inferred.

deadlinePredicate.year: 0x82D1137C reads signed32 current year 0x8312B8E0. Compare 0x82D11380 and branch 0x82D11384 bypass this arm to 0x82D1143C when year<2100; equality and larger signed years continue.
deadlinePredicate.rank: 0x82D11388..0x82D11394 requires unsigned16[Q]==0. Selected setup 0x82D110B8/0x82D110CC supplies frame+0x78 with Q=0x830E9200; 0x82D11710..0x82D11730 advances Q by 32 with the player loop. Under loop and frame state that stays valid, Q=0x830E9200+32*p. The accepted ordinal producer gives this column a zero-based rank role, not a calendar or elapsed-turn role.
deadlinePredicate.scenario: The sampled 0x8312B8D4 word reaches 0x82D11398. Exactly 0xFFFFFFFF bypasses the elapsed check. Every other value requires signed32(currentTurn-startTurn)>=200 at 0x82D113A0..0x82D113B0, using 0x8312B8DC and 0x8312B8D8. The subtraction is native low32 arithmetic, followed by a signed compare.
deadlinePredicate.request: If all three local checks pass, 0x82D113B4..0x82D113BC requests 0x82D02AB8(p,1). This arm does not locally call victory-setting helper 0x82CEEA50(1), which controls the separate ordinary Domination arm.
deadlinePredicate.entryAndIteration: The evaluator first bypasses work when 0x82FFE7C4 bit 0x80 is set, and returns 1 when sampled byte 0x8314EF9F is nonzero. A positive player count is required for the loop, which skips the sampled barbarian ordinal. Earlier victory arms, helpers and callbacks can prevent a selected iteration from reaching this deadline. These local guards do not establish active membership or invocation cadence.
deadlinePredicate.warning: Only the selected local player reaches the warning tests: helper call 0x82D11308 and compare and branch 0x82D11310/14 precede them. Compare 0x82D11320 tests signed current year==2090; scenario==-1 at 0x82D11328/2C allows the warning. Otherwise 0x82D11338/3C tests signed low32(currentTurn-startTurn)==195 and 0x82D11344/48 requires scenario!=-1. These are separate year and elapsed-turn tests, not one shared limit field.

inputAndResultBoundary.calendarProducer: The accepted transition 0x82D1EAB0 increments 0x8312B8DC, calls converter 0x82CEFA20 and stores 0x8312B8E0. No deadline literal or replacement value is supplied by that converter. Coherent values, and publication to this evaluator that stays valid, remain necessary.
inputAndResultBoundary.localStores: With valid p and normal prefix completion, 0x82D02AF4 stores rank 1 at 0x83122898+4*p and 0x82D02AFC stores supplied type 1 at 0x831228B8+4*p. Stores 0x82D02B08/0x82D02B10 snapshot the sampled turn and year at 0x831228DC/0x831228E0. The following loop copies eight score words into the result block. These stores precede later result-writer helpers and do not certify its completed return or a visible game ending.
inputAndResultBoundary.continuation: After the result request and the local-player helper, which runs only under a condition, 0x82D113F0 requests the current slot+0x1C4 through the object at 0x8314F76C. Requests through its freshly read slot+0x80 follow at 0x82D1140C and 0x82D11428. Installed targets, helper returns, whether the object and frame stay valid, and delivered effects are unresolved. The later flag bit 0x80 test can return 1 or continue to the next victory arm.
inputAndResultBoundary.nextDiscriminator: For a reached deadline iteration, tie together the original p, sampled year, rank, scenario, turn and start, completed 0x82D02AB8 return and actual current 0x8314F76C, table and slot+0x1C4 at 0x82D113F0. A prefix write or a configured callback address alone does not establish ending or continued play.

candidateIntervention.smallestScope: A candidate policy can change this deadline acceptance and its separate warning tests, keeping bypass destination 0x82D1143C and the other evaluator arms. Bypassing from 0x82D11304 skips both warning and deadline; a finite extension must keep the rank and scenario elapsed 200 checks unless separately specified.
candidateIntervention.preservation: Keep ordinary palace-based Domination and its elapsed-ten-turn and enabled-victory checks, the other victory conditions, shared result writer, native calendar conversion, ordinary turn-transition flow and peer-authoritative state consistent. Changing the converter, shared result writer or all type 1 results would affect separate behavior.
candidateIntervention.remainingRequirements: The warning needs a coherent finite and scenario policy. Actual dispatch, coherent calendar, rank and scenario inputs, whether helpers and callbacks stay valid, other endings, supported arithmetic domains, save and load of continued games and peer compatibility remain requirements. The census is not an exhaustive reader proof; static evidence proves no complete feature.

checks.predicateWitnesses: Twelve static cases cover years below, at and above 2100, zero, nonzero and 0xFFFF rank, exact -1 versus other scenario values, elapsed 199, 200 and 201, a signed-negative year and native wrapped signed subtraction. The zero-rank and sentinel conditions cannot be dropped.
checks.calendarWitnesses: The converter reaches 2100, 2200, 2300 and 2500 at absolute turns 193, 243, 293 and 393; five steps earlier gives 2090, 2190, 2290 and 2490. See game-calendar-state.json#/lateCalendar for the domain. These are static examples; scenario elapsed 200 remains a separate check.
checks.aliasQualification: The rank formula requires the selected frame+0x78 base, successive +32 advances, an unchanged p and valid backing. Helper or computed alias writes can invalidate that mapping or freshness; numeral equality alone does not establish the same generation. Result-block stores also require valid nonaliasing player, index and frame state.

currentEvidence.method: Serialized foreground read-only Ghidra function metadata and radius-zero native word queries, independent supported-flat-image hash and word comparison and operand decoding, narrow exact-function generated corroboration and static arithmetic checks.
currentEvidence.verification: All 202 queried words in these windows matched the flat image pinned by image.json. The loop-entry read supplied four words at 0x82D11150..0x82D1115C; the other windows supplied 198 words. Independent opcode, register, immediate and branch assertions checked 31 critical native words against the flat image. They checked signed year and elapsed compares, unsigned rank load and compare, exact sentinel branch, rank-pointer setup and advance, barbarian exclusion, result request and initial result and snapshot stores. Twelve predicate cases and three converter examples passed.
currentEvidence.qualification: The configured Ghidra models truncate the evaluator and result writer after save-register thunks. Their metadata identifies entries only; native words and narrow generated windows support the stated local contracts, not complete coverage of the functions. No new runtime observation was made.

limitExtension.verification: 845 requested native word rows across three batches, 772 distinct addresses, all matched image.json; 22 critical opcode assertions, 277 late-curve arithmetic cases, four cap and warning triples and 15 proposed scenario-policy cases passed. Repeated windows count as repeated rows, not independent evidence. No game was launched.
limitExtension.additionalScope: Selected immediate candidates, complete 0x821BD0E0, 0x82D5E1D8, 0x82DBA080 and 0x82DC1E08, and limited address-construction windows were also word-checked. Inline jump tables are data, not decoded instructions.

guards: A native year>=2100 arm is supported independently of any reported playthrough; the report alone does not establish the owner's executed path.
Do not conflate displayed calendar progression, scenario elapsed turns, ranking freshness or the ordinary Domination minimum with this deadline predicate.
No complete game-ending, sole deadline, successful dispatch, save and load, multiplayer or unlimited-turn result follows from these static windows.
Runtime acceptance must cover play before, at and beyond the previous deadline, unchanged ordinary victories, and reload and resumption of the continued game.
conclusion: The selected evaluator requests a separate deadline result when signed currentYear>=2100, the selected player's ranking halfword is zero, and either scenario==-1 or signed elapsedTurns>=200. This arm is distinct from ordinary Domination but requests the same type 1 result writer that ordinary Domination uses. This is a candidate for a limited intervention. Actual ending or continuation, current dispatch, whether values stay valid, and persistence are not yet established.

warningBoundary.message: The pointer formed at 0x82D110D0/0x82D11108 and saved at frame+0x8C by 0x82D11118 is 0x8214D170. The selected formatting request consumes it; its independent summary is a five-turn advance warning with highest-score Domination wording. It contains no selected replacement year. Actual localization, formatting and presentation completion are not yet established.
warningBoundary.lead: At the native late-calendar step of two years per turn, year 2090 is five converter steps before year 2100. Scenario elapsed 195 is five steps before elapsed 200, but the deadline also requires year>=2100. Late starts or changed year thresholds can separate those two boundaries.
warningBoundary.singleSubstitution: No shared deadline-setting field is read here. Replacing only the 2100 compare leaves year 2090 and elapsed 195 warnings unchanged; replacing the converter changes separate gameplay and presentation consumers. Preserving a five-turn warning for an extended scenario deadline needs its own policy.

literalSearchBoundary.method: Aligned initialized mapped words, mask 0xFC00FFFF, cap 128 per form. Tested cmpwi, cmplwi and addi forms for positive 2100 and 2090 and addi forms for negative 2100 and 2090. None reached the cap; each reported word matched image.json.
literalSearchBoundary.comparisonCandidates: Besides the deadline compare, 0x821BD0E0 tests an incoming code against 30, 1200, 1220, 40, 50 and 2100, with its 2100 compare at 0x821BD108. 0x82D5E1D8 and 0x82DBA080 test an incoming value against 3100, 2006, 2100 and 5010, with their 2100 compares at 0x82D5E348 and 0x82DBA1F0. 0x82DC1E24 in 0x82DC1E08 rejects signed r4 above 2100 before a store at object+0x11C. Within the inspected scope these are request codes, not calendar limits (see requestCodeBoundary). Complete selected bodies do not read the current-year global. The source of the value tested in 0x82D5E1D8 and 0x82DBA080 was not traced, so none of these is an accepted deadline replacement site.
literalSearchBoundary.addressAndCodeCandidates: Five positive addi candidates add 2100 to nonzero register bases and were not inspected further. 0x82DF86F0 instead loads literal 2100 into r4 for 0x82DC22A0, only when the record code is 1200; it is a request code (see requestCodeBoundary). Negative-addi candidates include address construction. These are numeric matches, not shown to be year-limit readers.

requestCodeBoundary.question: Are the other immediate 2100 values in this search calendar year limits that a Turn Limit above 2100 would have to change?
requestCodeBoundary.membershipTest: 0x821BD0E0..0x821BD11C is a complete leaf of 16 words. It returns 1 when signed r4 equals one of 30, 1200, 1220, 40, 50 or 2100, and otherwise 0. The compares are at 0x821BD0E0, 0x821BD0E8, 0x821BD0F0, 0x821BD0F8, 0x821BD100 and 0x821BD108.
requestCodeBoundary.stateTable: 0x82DF8410..0x82DF87BC is complete (236 words). It returns when byte object+0x464 is nonzero, and otherwise sets that byte. It works on five 12-byte records at 0x82FFD630: word +0 is the current code, word +4 an elapsed counter and word +8 the next code. Each record starts with code 30. The function handles each record whose object pointer is nonzero (pointer array at object+0x458, stride 0x14). 0x82DF8674 calls 0x82E59F98(object, code). The float return times the float at 0x8216A530 (1000.0) becomes an integer period, with 0 replaced by 1. The counter adds the word at 0x8314F04C. 0x82DF86D4 calls 0x82DC22A0(object, code, counter modulo period, 0). Only when the code equals 1200 (0x82DF86DC), 0x82DF86F0 loads literal 2100 into r4 and 0x82DF8718 calls 0x82DC22A0(object, 2100, counter modulo period, 1). When the counter plus the 0x8314F04C word exceeds the period, code 1200 sets next code 50 (0x82DF874C) and code 1220 sets next code 40 (0x82DF8744). Then the code becomes the next code and the counter is zeroed. The codes this function writes or passes are 30, 40, 50, 1200, 1220 and 2100, which is exactly the set accepted by 0x821BD0E0. Its only direct caller is 0x82DF89DC.
requestCodeBoundary.codeRequest: 0x82DC22A0..0x82DC23AC is complete (68 words). r4 is the code and r5 an integer time. It looks up object+0x28 in the registry at 0x831560D0 through 0x822FBD80, and passes the result and the code to 0x82C7AFD8. That function truncates the code to 16 bits at 0x82C7B01C before calling 0x82C96528. A zero result at either step returns early. At 0x82DC234C, r5 is sign-extended, converted to float and multiplied by the float at 0x8216A524 (0.001). Then 0x82C95D60 is called with the word at object+0x14. The only direct callers are 0x82DF86D4 and 0x82DF8718 (aligned raw bl scan, cap 64, not truncated).
requestCodeBoundary.setter: 0x82DC1E08..0x82DC1E60 is complete (23 words). r4 is the code. A signed code above 2100 (0x82DC1E24, 0x82DC1E28) returns with no store. Otherwise, when the word at object+0x14 is nonzero, it calls 0x82C95788, and 0x82DC1E48 stores the code at object+0x11C. The only direct caller is 0x82DA6E70, inside 0x82DA6BF0 (same scan). It passes its entry r8, kept in r26, and reaches the call only when signed r26 is at least 2000 (0x82DA6E4C, 0x82DA6E50). That caller therefore stores codes 2000 through 2100.
requestCodeBoundary.secondCodeSet: 0x82D5E334..0x82D5E354 (in 0x82D5E1D8) and 0x82DBA1DC..0x82DBA1FC (in 0x82DBA080) apply the same test of r3 against 3100, 2006, 2100 and 5010. Any match branches to 0x82D5E360 or 0x82DBA208. The words just before each test are inline jump table data. The source of r3 was not traced.
requestCodeBoundary.addImmediates: Six raw addi words have immediate 2100. 0x82DF86F0 has base r0 and is the literal load described above. Five add 2100 to a base register: 0x826B206C (r24), 0x82AB91B4, 0x82ABA3D8, 0x82ABAC6C and 0x82ABD020 (r31). Those five were not inspected further.
requestCodeBoundary.noCalendarRead: No word in the four complete bodies (0x821BD0E0, 0x82DF8410, 0x82DC22A0 and 0x82DC1E08) has low 16 bits 0xB8D4, 0xB8D8, 0xB8DC or 0xB8E0. None of them directly addresses the scenario, start turn, current turn (0x8312B8DC) or current year (0x8312B8E0) scalar. Their callees were not inspected.
requestCodeBoundary.verification: One foreground read-only DumpMemoryWords query requested 810 word rows, covering 808 distinct addresses, and all matched image.json. The eight windows hold 401 words in total. 37 opcode and operand assertions passed. One foreground read-only FindDirectCallers query covered targets 0x82DC1E08, 0x82DC22A0 and 0x82DF8410, with cap 64 per target, and was not truncated. It covers direct bl only; indirect, tail and computed callers are not covered. Ghidra has no usable model of these functions: 0x82DC1E08 decompiles as bad data, 0x82DC22A0 truncates after its save thunk and 0x82DF86F0 has no containing function. The claims rest on native words and the recompiled copies. No game was launched.
requestCodeBoundary.qualification: The meaning of the codes, the object types, the dynamic inputs of the callers and any indirect caller are unresolved. This covers only the listed aligned immediate forms, and the qualification of literalSearchBoundary still applies. Other opcode forms, data and resource constants, computed or indirect readers, formatter descendants and HUD or advisor providers are not covered. This is a static result. It does not show that dates above 2100 display correctly, or that a longer game ends or continues correctly.
requestCodeBoundary.result: Within the inspected scope none of these sites is a calendar limit. The deadline compare at 0x82D11380 and the warning compare at 0x82D11320 stay the only shown year limit tests, and a higher Turn Limit needs no change at these sites. This is a static result.

literalSearchBoundary.qualification: This covers only the listed aligned immediate forms. Other opcode forms, constants in data and resources, computed, indirect or aliased readers, formatter descendants, HUD and advisor providers and other ending paths are not exhaustively covered. Do not globally replace every occurrence of 2100.
